race.title: GAIN Equine Nutrition Novice Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: KOME DANS UN REVE has found some progression on his last 2 starts, staying on well to open his account at Limerick, and with the run of this race promising to suit he can score again now that he's up and running. Firebrand arrives on the back of a career best effort and is next on the list, ahead of Papagei . KOME DANS UN REVE (FR) FIREBRAND (GER) PAPAGEI
race.bettingForecast: Facile Ocean (9/4), Cocofred (4/1), Firebrand (4/1), Papagei (9/2), Kome Dans Un Reve (7/1), Siorai (14/1), Sinbad My Dad (20/1), Bell Ex Too (20/1), Figero (25/1)
